evidence: The paper states: "Feature selection within the model fitting was implemented using the permutated importance metric. Variants achieving an importance > 1 × 10^-5 were accepted into the model." The conclusions focus entirely on prediction accuracy ("the mean overall accuracy of prediction was 0.985 (95% CI [0.970–0.992]%)"), not on variable importance rankings or magnitudes. Importance is used only for feature selection filtering, not for substantive claims about SNP effects.
